scope.installation: Local installed starsector-core snapshot (localized/possibly modified); hashes, not a clean-vanilla claim.
scope.manifestOrder: Preserved from single-root factions.csv; does not promise FactionManager HashMap iteration order.
scope.modOverlays: not-supported: no mod search order, fullOverrides or LoadingUtils overlay merge executed
scope.inheritance: not-supported: no faction parent chain in reviewed SpecStore; no default.faction inferred
scope.shipRoles: raw-only: default and local pools retained; selection, includeDefault and doctrine not executed
scope.assetPaths: strings-only: logo/crest paths retained; image existence, copying and browser asset URLs are not handled by this importer
scope.runtimeOverrides: not-supported: names/colors/known technology/player customization are world state, not immutable definitions

engineLazyFallback.note: Low-level absent-relation allocation only, NOT final new-game diplomatic state.

additionalStages.note: Starts hegemony/tritachyon, hegemony/persean, tritachyon/luddic_church hostilities when manager is absent.
Creates FactionHostilityIntel if this pair has no ongoing hostilities.
Stores initial relationship, sets HOSTILE, and restores initial relationship when the event ends; this is stateful behavior, not a permanent definition default.

relationships.completeness: SectorGen method statements are source evidence only. RepLevel conversion, hostilities, other scripts and player-start changes are not applied. No relation matrix exported.
